    • Method Detail

      • getBedLocations

        @Nullable
@Nullable java.util.List<org.bukkit.Location> getBedLocations()
        If the match is a bed fight match, this will return the both locations of the bed block of this player's team. If this match is not a bed fight match, this will return null. This can also return null if the map was not setup properly.
        Returns:
        List of Location or null
